case: Four concurrent catalog projections in a deeply nested source-only Windows workspace
error: SQLITE_ERROR14: unable to open database file at BEGIN IMMEDIATE
diagnosis: The SQLite Windows VFS used a normal path; its longer rollback journal exceeded legacy MAX_PATH. A new independent path above300characters reproduced the failure before repair.
repair: Use path.toNamespacedPath for DatabaseSync open, VACUUM INTO and backup reopen. Keep ordinary logical paths and all namespace/symlink checks.

afterRepairTargetedSuite.includes: Commit/reopen/consistent backup above300characters, four writers preserving60distinct entries, existing storage and journal tests

scope: Actual native SQLite/filesystem regression; no financial or human-wallet transaction. Failed immutable Git-source run preserved; a new complete source run is still required. No test assertion or timeout was weakened.
